svg.title: Module-owned provider snapshots
svg.desc: A module owns the options provider. Each listener captures a shared snapshot, allowing later provider replacement. An empty provider disables new listeners. Existing listeners keep their captured provider. This ownership and synchronization code is new, not relocated from ParsedAST.
svg.text: A module owns the options provider. Each listener captures a shared snapshot, allowing later provider replacement.
/// The Options provider to use when running clang-tidy. If null, clang-tidy
// Used to acquire ASTListeners when parsing files.
/// Construct explicitly with the application's clang-tidy options provider.
/// Takes ownership of the provider; an empty provider disables checks.
/// Swap provider snapshots, e.g. to temporarily override the configuration
/// for benchmarking and restore it afterwards. Existing listeners retain
An empty provider disables new listeners. Existing listeners keep their captured provider.
This ownership and synchronization code is new, not relocated from ParsedAST.
Colors follow git diff · unchanged context is gray · arrows map responsibilities, not entire excerpts
